The first release of **PockPock Agent**: a private AI assistant and agent that runs entirely on your own computer. Your chats and files stay on it.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

## Install

1. **Windows:** open the downloaded file. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. PockPock installs and opens by itself.
   **Mac:** open the downloaded file and drag **PockPock Agent** into **Applications**. The first time you open it, macOS says it cannot check the app: press **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, and press **Open Anyway** next to PockPock Agent.
2. In PockPock, press **Set up PockPock**. It checks your computer, picks an AI model that runs well on it, and downloads and installs everything it needs. This takes about 10 to 60 minutes, depending on your internet connection. You do not need to install anything else.
3. When setup says **PockPock is ready**, press **Start using PockPock**.

You need about 15 GB of free disk space and an internet connection during setup. PockPock works best with 16 GB of memory or more and an NVIDIA graphics card, or an Apple silicon Mac.

## What you can do

- **Chat** with an AI model running on your computer.
- **Give a task to an agent.** It shows you its plan first, asks before it changes anything, checks its own work, and tells you how long each step took.
- **Let OpenClaw work on your computer**, with your approval for each action, or **NemoClaw** in a sandbox that cannot touch your files.
- **Add skills and tools** from a link, and see every service PockPock runs on one page.

## Good to know

- The Mac versions have not been tested on a real Mac yet. Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
